pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Spatial area of individual patches is maximal on the upper flank and neck base, decreasing in size towards the distal limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with multiple 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the upper body, approximately 1/5th the average width of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour along the dorsal ridge of the neck, presenting a jagged silhouette against the low-contrast background.
